# FitBudd

> > FitBudd is a white-label fitness app platform that enables personal trainers, coaches, and yoga studios to launch custom-branded iOS and Android apps with workout planning, client management, and integrated payment processing.

FitBudd provides comprehensive personal trainer software with features including workout builders, client check-ins, nutrition tracking, and payment integration via Stripe and PayPal. The platform serves fitness professionals across the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia, positioning itself as an alternative to platforms like Trainerize, Everfit, and Vagaro.

## Key Topics

- Custom branded fitness apps
- Personal trainer software
- Client management tools
- Workout planning and programming
- iOS and Android app development
- Stripe and PayPal payment integration
- Online coaching platforms
- Fitness business growth strategies
- White-label fitness solutions
- Yoga studio management
- Pricing comparisons (Trainerize, Everfit, Vagaro)
- Fitness marketing and lead generation
- Free trial offerings
- Business automation for trainers
- Nutrition and meal planning features
